description: This file defines the CandidateModel class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, representing a data model for candidate information in the API. It uses traits and annotations to set serialization filters and schema details, and links to an internal Candidate entity.

classes.name: CandidateModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing candidate data in the recruitment API, implementing Normalizable and using traits for serialization behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Candidate entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
